pro_course_detail.description:
In this interactive group class for kids, we will focus on developing essential basic grammar skills and enhancing conversation practice.
Basic Grammar: Students will be introduced to fundamental grammar concepts, including parts of speech, sentence structure, and punctuation. Through structured activities, they will learn to identify and use these elements correctly in their writing and speaking. The emphasis will be on understanding how grammar forms the foundation of effective communication.

They will practice speaking in English by participating in discussions, role-playing scenarios, and sharing their thoughts on various topics. This will help them apply the grammar rules they’ve learned in a practical context, boosting their confidence in using English in everyday conversations.
